title: Port Security Violation Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose and resolve Layer 2 switchport port security faults across Cisco Catalyst access switches. Analyze stale sticky MAC address conflicts, recover interfaces latched in err-disabled state without disabling security, and reconfigure violation modes from silent drop (protect) to audit-compliant (restrict/shutdown).
learning_objectives: Diagnose port security violation symptoms and error-disabled port states using Cisco IOS show commands
Resolve sticky MAC address collisions resulting from workstation hardware replacements and stale configuration entries
Execute the standard administrative recovery sequence (shutdown followed by no shutdown) to restore error-disabled switchports without removing security controls
Evaluate differences in security posture, logging, and operational behavior between protect, restrict, and shutdown violation modes
Verify end-to-end IP reachability for recovered legitimate endpoints while ensuring unauthorized devices trigger active security enforcement

source.origin: Independently authored network security troubleshooting laboratory guide based on IEEE 802.1D and Cisco IOS switchport port security architecture
